entities.summary: Erin Buescher Perperoglou is an American former professional basketball player. In her WNBA career, Perperoglou played more than 2,500 minutes in 150 WNBA games, including 9 playoff games, scoring nearly 900 career points and accumulating 500 rebounds. She announced her retirement from the WNBA at the conclusion of the 2009 season.
